caption:
OpenAI released 'The Builder’s Guide to GPT-5.6', detailing how startups are scaling autonomous AI agents faster and with lower operational costs.

Instead of making monolithic API calls to a single huge model, modern builder architectures leverage smarter model selection and the new Responses API to route task micro-steps dynamically.

Here is how the economics of AI agents are shifting from brute-force compute to intelligent task orchestration.

Source: OpenAI News (The builder’s guide to GPT-5.6)

Slide 3: SMARTER ROUTING REDUCES COST.. GPT-5.6 introduces smarter model selection and dynamic Responses API capabilities engineered for multi-step workflows. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.
